arStrings.szText: Killing {c_highlight}Headless Husks{/c} or {c_highlight}Fugitive Heads{/c} increases the chance of spawning an {c_highlight}Exposed Root{/c}.
The {c_highlight}Season Journey{/c} can be found in the {c_highlight}Seasons{/c} tab in the Menu.
Silencing the Tree's {c_highlight}Whispers{/c} will earn you the {c_highlight}Coven's Favor{/c}. Use it to continue the Seasonal quest line and gain access to various rewards.
{c_highlight}Seasonal items{/c} only last the current season. Seasonal characters will be moved to the {c_highlight}Eternal Realm{/c} when the current season ends.
Pull up {c_highlight}Exposed Roots{/c} for a chance to discover an {c_highlight}Uprooted Cocoon{/c}. One of the Tree's {c_highlight}Fugitive Heads{/c} may be inside.
During the Season of Witchcraft, you may find rare {c_rare}Seasonal Elixirs{/c}. These offer powerful effects to hasten progress, but will expire at the end of the season.
Follow the {icon:Quest_Season_Progress, 2.0}{c_highlight}Seasonal Quest marker{/c} on the Map or in the Journal to explore Seasonal content.
Reclaim {c_highlight}Fugitive Heads{/c} during {c_highlight}Headhunts{/c} and in {c_highlight}Rootholds{/c}. Exchange the heads with Gelena for powerful new {c_highlight}Occult Gems{/c}.
